caption: The drawing depicts a black and gray metallic object with a rounded circular top and two curved legs that extend outwards, ending in flat feet. The main object is shaded to show depth and dimension, with the darkness of the shading indicating a metallic or cast iron surface. To the left of the main object, there is a smaller outline drawing of the same object in front-view, with a scale labeled "INCHES" ranging from 0 to 6 beneath it. To the right, there is another smaller outline drawing of the object from the side view, also in black lines but minimally shaded. The composition is centered, with the main object in the foreground, while the two outline drawings and the scale appear in the background. The artist's signature, "Mildred Ford," is visible near the lower right corner. The background of the drawing is a light cream color, and all elements are contained within a thin rectangular border.
title: Andiron (One of Pair)
